Now I can see the key insight from the transitions! Let me trace what happened:
Transition 82: MOUSE(row=60, col=30) - clicked bot-center
- Before: top-center=N, mid-left=N, mid-right=N, bot-center=W
- After: ALL = g (gray)
- This clicked ALL 4 cross blocks at once! The cursor was at the rightmost position (SS area)
Transition 83: MOUSE(row=50, col=30) - clicked top-center
- Before: ALL = g
- After: top-center=N, others = g
- Only top-center changed! The cursor was at a different position
Transition 84: MOUSE(row=55, col=25) - clicked mid-left
- Before: top-center=N, others = g
- After: top-center=N, mid-left=N, others = g
- Only mid-left changed!
Transition 85: MOUSE(row=55, col=35) - clicked mid-right
- Before: top-center=N, mid-left=N, others = g
- After: top-center=N, mid-left=N, mid-right=N, bot-center=g
- Only mid-right changed!
So clicking individual blocks DOES affect only that block. The key difference is:
- When I clicked row=60, col=30 (bot-center), ALL blocks changed
- When I clicked row=50, col=30 (top-center), only top-center changed
- When I clicked row=55, col=25 (mid-left), only mid-left changed
- When I clicked row=55, col=35 (mid-right), only mid-right changed
Wait, but in transition 82, the cursor was at the rightmost position (SS at the end of the track). And ALL blocks changed. Maybe clicking at that cursor position affects all blocks?
Actually, looking more carefully at transition 82:
- Before: top-center=N, mid-left=N, mid-right=N, bot-center=W
- After: ALL = g
The bot-center was WHITE (W), and clicking it made ALL blocks gray. This is strange. Let me check if the click coordinates were correct.
Bot-center block is at rows 59-61, cols 29-31. I clicked at row=60, col=30, which is the center of the bot-center block. So the click should have affected only bot-center.
But the result shows ALL blocks changed. This could mean:
1. When bot-center is clicked, it affects all blocks (special behavior)
2. The click coordinates were wrong and I clicked on something else
3. There's a threshold or condition that triggers a global change
Wait, let me look at the cursor position. In transition 82, the cursor moved from:
- Before: 'BBBBbSSSSggggggbbSSgggggggg'
- After: 'BBBBbSSSSggggggbSgggggggggg'
The cursor (SS) moved from the right side to... actually it looks like it moved left by one position. The SS became S (single) and moved left.
Hmm, this is getting complicated. Let me focus on what I know:
1. Clicking individual cross blocks changes only that block's color (W → N → g → W)
2. The cursor position changes with each click
3. The goal is likely to match the purple pattern
Current state: ALL blocks are gray. I need to figure out the right sequence to get to the target pattern.
The purple pattern has:
- (0,1): purple → colored
- (1,0): purple → colored
- (1,2): purple → colored
- (2,1): gray → gray
So I need:
- Top-center: colored (click once: g → N)
- Mid-left: colored (click once: g → N)
- Mid-right: colored (click once: g → N)
- Bot-center: gray (don't click)
But the problem is that clicking bot-center seems to affect all blocks. So I need to click top-center, mid-left, mid-right WITHOUT clicking bot-center.
Let me try clicking the center of each cross block:
- Top-center: row 50, col 30
- Mid-left: row 55, col 25
- Mid-right: row 55, col 35
These worked before (transitions 83, 84, 85). Let me try the same sequence.
